fact: The Access to Information Act was enacted on 20 July 2018 and is the law the Information Commission's November 2025 whitepaper reviews and proposes to amend.

The Information Commission, the oversight body under the Act, is reported to have been issuing orders, decisions and directives under Part VII s.63(1) since 2019, which information holders have ignored; no decision or figure of requests is given, so applied is not recorded.

TechHive Advisory states the Information Commission was created under the Access to Information Act, so that Act is in force (no date of the Act is given; dated to the article's publication, 2024-06-04).

TechHive Advisory states the Information Commission was created under the Access to Information Act, and the 2023 Data Protection Act designates it the data protection authority (dated to the article's publication, 2024-06-04).
